title: Config precedence
skill: Give the precedence order and the type rules

good: In src/config/load.js, loadConfig(defaults, file, env, cli) spreads env after cli, keeps env values as strings, and keeps unknown APP_ keys. Rules: precedence cli > env > file > defaults; for each APP_ variable, get the key with keyFromEnv(), skip it if the key is not in defaults, and convert the string to the type of defaults[key] (number: Number(v); boolean: "true" -> true, "false" -> false; string: unchanged). Ignore variables without APP_. Do not convert file or cli values. Only change that file. Then run: node --test --test-reporter=tap test/*.test.js
